name: sormena-provision-claims
description: Sormena Auth M1 - set Firebase Auth custom claims on the approved accounts. Implements docs/architecture/auth-m1-provisioning.md. Isolated from scripts/migration (own package.json / own node_modules).

scripts.note: Default run is DRY-RUN (no writes). Requires GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS. Do not npm install or run without explicit approval - see the design doc.
